name: spider-queries-train
description: Training split of the Spider family that provides natural-language questions paired with SQL queries for cross-domain text-to-SQL learning. It is used to train and evaluate semantic-parsing and text-to-SQL models on generalization across unseen databases and schemas. Primarily intended as a training resource aligned with the Spider benchmark.
reputation: Widely used standard dataset/resource within the text-to-SQL and semantic-parsing research community.
